text:
sam_sales: Urgent: SunriseBank POC showing 429s on /v1/authorize during a scheduled demo prep. Demo in 25m.

leo_se: Which tenant and req id? Any rate-limit headers?

sam_sales: tenant=sunrise-poc, req=req_sb_11x. Header: X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 Retry-After:5. They spun up ~45 parallel tabs.

anya_engineer: Likely token bucket exhaustion. Short-term options: grant a short burst or route demo traffic to a smaller model to reduce token usage. Ops, can you apply a 20m burst?

ops_oncall: I can apply `POST /internal/admin/tenants/sunrise-poc/burst {"minutes":20,"qps":350}`. Need SE approval. Ticket OPS-1305.

leo_se: Approve burst. Also send client backoff snippet (max concurrency=8, exponential backoff with jitter). I'll attach it in chat.

ops_oncall: Burst applied for 20m. Watching ingress for req_sb_11x.

anya_engineer: Ingress log tail:
```
[INGRESS] 2026-12-15T14:05:12Z tenant=sunrise-poc req=req_sb_11x route=/v1/authorize status=429 concurrent=45
[INGRESS] 2026-12-15T14:05:13Z tenant=sunrise-poc req=req_sb_11x route=/v1/authorize status=200 lat_ms=160
```

sam_sales: Demo resumed, customer completed walk-through. They asked about guaranteed capacity for peak payroll windows and enterprise pricing.

morgan_cs: I'll open a follow-up to discuss Reserved QPS and Dedicated trial. Also creating a short demo playbook for sales: client concurrency guidance + burst request process.

leo_se: Postmortem items: publish backoff snippet in playbook, add one-click burst in Console (audit-logged), and propose Dedicated sizing for their peak.

sam_sales: Thanks team. Closing this thread and scheduling post-demo pricing call. :thumbsup:
